ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Potential Wrongdoing
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential wrongdoing by the Trump administration, including the Mar-a-Lago investigation and allegations of Medicaid payment errors in Minnesota
questions: What is the extent of the Trump administration's potential wrongdoing?
How are the Mar-a-Lago investigation and Medicaid payment errors in Minnesota related?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing by the Trump administration. By following the money and investigating the connections between the Mar-a-Lago investigation and Medicaid payment errors, we may be able to expose a larger pattern of corruption.
